title: Pitch-Knock Reggaeton 808
description: A punchy melodic 808 sub bass with a sharp downward pitch-glide knock on every hit, stepping through a reggaeton note pattern in the low register. The filter cutoff, saturation grit, and resonance all drift on mutually-prime LFO clocks so the loop breathes and evolves — tight and percussive on the attack, warm and deep in the sustain.
code:
setcpm(96/4)
stack(
  note("<c1 c1 g0 eb1>*4").s("sine")
    .penv("<12 12 18 -6>/8").pattack(0.001).pdecay(0.09)
    .lpf(sine.slow(11).range(280, 1800)).resonance(sine.slow(13).range(6, 16)).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(sine.slow(32).range(2, 8)).lpattack(0.002).lpdecay(0.18)
    .attack(0.001).decay(0.28).sustain(0.55).release(0.08)
    .shape(sine.slow(16).range(0.15, 0.55))
    .distort(sine.slow(29).range(0.0, 0.4))
    .crush(saw.slow(13).range(14, 7))
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.3, 0.7))
    .off(0.125, x => x.add(note(12)).hpf(600).gain(0.22).pan(0.75))
    .room(0.12).postgain(1.05).gain(0.92)
)
